selection.name: C08: tobi/qmd
selection.role: Controlled Markdown collections, lexical/hybrid retrieval, and full-body reads through CLI or MCP. Refresh the index before relying on cached content.

basis.shows: Named collections, inclusion/exclusion controls, metadata filters, BM25/vector/hybrid search, and qmd get --full. CLI and MCP expose search followed by document-body retrieval. CUDA and Metal backend selection are documented.
Tests verify document-body retrieval and source line numbers. Model-backed vector and full hybrid groups are skipped in CI.
Fixture-based relevance assertions include easy-query Hit@3 >=80% and overall Hit@3 >=40%; these are regression thresholds, not comparative benchmark results.
GitHub API reported successful Node 22/23 test jobs on Ubuntu and macOS; Bun jobs also succeeded. This supports platform maintenance, not WSL2/RTX 4090 performance.
Unarchived repository; latest default-branch commit September 9, 2026, inside the 90-day window.
Latest release August 16, 2026, inside the window.
Issue activity continued October 1, including an unresolved report of query memory exhaustion; the report was not independently reproduced.

selection.name: C03: MinerU
selection.role: Controlled document discovery, parsing, search, and page/block source reads. Use normal-quality parsing before trusting discovery snippets; retain native originals. QMD covers native Markdown ingestion.

basis.shows: Document parsing and Markdown export; scan/watch controls; indexed search; stable document/tier/page/block locators and read continuation. Flash discovery is explicitly distinguished from final reading quality. Native Markdown is read directly rather than parsed into this library.

Documents Linux NVIDIA standard parsing with the full extra and Apple Silicon standard parsing. The target's 24 GB VRAM and 104 GB RAM exceed stated minimums by inference; installation and throughput remain untested.
Published PDF parsing scores: MinerU2.5-Pro 95.75, MinerU-2.5 93.04, MinerU-Pipeline 86.47. These evaluate named variants, not the default MinerU 4.0 installation or its retrieval workflow.
Observed CLI check succeeded, but its workflow explicitly checks out dev; it does not establish test success for the selected default-branch pin.
Documents retained orchestration/CLI/library tests, parser regression migration to DocVortex, and three existing metadata/LaTeX assertion failures.
Unarchived repository; release and latest default-branch commit September 29, 2026, inside the window.
Recent issue activity includes an unresolved numerical table-recognition report; it was not independently reproduced.

not_selected.name: LlamaIndex

not_selected.name: MarkItDown
not_selected.reason: Current: commit October 1, release September 21. [README](https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown/blob/1f9530a6d35364886a038dc2dcb34256bb0c85b0/README.md); [test workflow](https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown/blob/1f9530a6d35364886a038dc2dcb34256bb0c85b0/.github/workflows/tests.yml).

not_selected.name: Poppler
not_selected.reason: Current mirror commit October 1; GitHub latest-release endpoint returned 404. Its PDF rendering/extraction utilities provide a narrower component than controlled corpus ingestion and retrieval. Observed macOS builds passed; AppVeyor failed. not_selected.name: pageindex
not_selected.reason: Current: commit and release October 1. Strong measured text-PDF lookup results, but its OSS benchmark excludes charts/tables and documents the local indexer rejects; that evidence does not establish the broad ingestion fit required here. [README](https://github.com/VectifyAI/PageIndex/blob/6d23caf416858f2ca136840305d1f479a86f6ef7/README.md); [62-question OSS evaluation](https://github.com/VectifyAI/PageIndex-OSS-Benchmark/blob/ad4c0b92970a6f4801f09ff2e647389e8f5874fa/README.md).

not_selected.name: Docling
not_selected.reason: Current: commit and release October 1. Closest ingestion alternative: broad formats, provenance, Linux/macOS arm64 support, and successful core/OCR/PDF/VLM CI. A native corpus discovery→search→body loop was not established in the inspected README/docs; current parsing superiority remains unresolved. [README](https://github.com/docling-project/docling/blob/bba2ec58fe58af1be630fea5cc0d35b0ad2a472e/README.md); [provenance](https://github.com/docling-project/docling/blob/bba2ec58fe58af1be630fea5cc0d35b0ad2a472e/docs/concepts/docling_document.md); [CI](https://github.com/docling-project/docling/actions/runs/36877114733).

not_selected.name: docs-mcp-server
not_selected.reason: Current: commit/release September 27. Strong controlled web/local ingestion and hybrid search; upstream reports MRR 0.747 on 59 queries. Exact stored full-body lookup was not found in the inspected README/usage: fetch-url retrieves a live representation, which can differ from indexed Markdown. Head checks were absent on the skip-ci release commit. [Benchmark](https://github.com/arabold/docs-mcp-server/blob/f2938c47bb8937c650f0d5ddb614f867773b29f4/docs/guides/benchmarking.md); [usage](https://github.com/arabold/docs-mcp-server/blob/f2938c47bb8937c650f0d5ddb614f867773b29f4/docs/guides/basic-usage.md); [representation tests](https://github.com/arabold/docs-mcp-server/blob/f2938c47bb8937c650f0d5ddb614f867773b29f4/test/markdown-identity-e2e.test.ts).

excluded.name: Context Hub
excluded.fact: Latest default-branch commit May 31, 2026, precedes the July 3 cutoff; latest release April 27. Recent repository updated_at and issue activity do not satisfy the frozen commit criterion. [Commit API](https://api.github.com/repos/andrewyng/context-hub/commits?per_page=1).

layers.deciding_comparison: The pair is selected on verified capability fit, without claiming measured superiority. On the WSL2/RTX 4090 host, seal one representative Markdown/PDF/Office corpus and relevance judgments. Randomize QMD versus Docs MCP lexical/hybrid retrieval and MinerU versus Docling difficult-layout ingestion at pinned versions. Measure coverage, Recall@5/nDCG@10, source-body fidelity, stale/deleted-source handling, table/formula accuracy, latency, RAM/VRAM, and clean-install success. Repeat platform checks on macOS arm64 before choosing permanent defaults.
evidence_gaps: The packet contains no comparisons where every named arm ran; published evaluations use different corpora, models, and versions.

ctx_fetch_and_index was rejected with 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Primary README/docs/test/evaluation blobs were recovered through GitHub's API, indexed, and read with ctx_search. Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, zero web searches, zero successful page fetches.
Neither target-host clean installation nor RTX 4090 performance was tested. QMD macOS CI passed, but arm64 runner architecture was not established from the inspected evidence.
QMD model-backed tests skip CI. MinerU CLI CI tests dev and documents existing local failures. Docling's reading-order benchmark skips CI, and its latest macOS lane was skipped.
QMD get returns indexed Markdown; MinerU read returns cached parsed pages/blocks. Refresh or reparse as appropriate, and retain native sources before relying on a result.
All repositories were unarchived. Currency was judged against October 1, 2026, using the July 3 cutoff. License information did not affect ranking.
